name: Tusker Trails  Powder Blue Short Kurta
description:
Product Description: 
Crafted in a soft, breathable fabric with a subtle natural sheen, the Tusker Trails kurta is designed for effortless festive dressing. The relaxed-fit silhouette is elevated with intricate tusker-inspired embroidery, featuring a striking pop of colour that adds depth and visual interest to the minimal base. Finished with a clean mandarin collar, it balances tradition with contemporary ease.
Styling:Style it with straight-fit jeans for a modern festive look, as paired, or dress it up with classic ethnic bottoms. Complete with mojaris or sleek leather footwear for a refined finish.Material: 100% Cotton
Color: Blue
Model Size: M
